name: Map tract endpoint ROIs to cortical surface for quantitative analyses - fsaverage
summary: Maps template-space (warped) tract endpoint ROIs onto an fsaverage cortical surface with FreeSurfer mri_vol2surf and Connectome Workbench, with optional volume and surface smoothing, as a cortexmap.
description: Uses a bundled fsaverage subject (chosen with the freesurfer parameter) instead of a subject FreeSurfer run, builds its GIFTI surfaces, and projects each ROI onto the surface with mri_vol2surf, optionally smoothing the ROI volume and the surface map. Use it for ROIs already warped to the fsaverage/MNI template space (tag warped); for native-space ROIs use the non-fsaverage endpoint App. Requires a FreeSurfer license.

inputs.description: Volumetric ROIs (e.g. tract endpoint ROIs) already warped to template space, as NIfTI files; each ROI is mapped onto the fsaverage surface.
inputs.requirements: ROIs must be in the template space of the chosen fsaverage subject.

inputs.description: Optional existing fsaverage cortexmap; if it contains fsaverage midthickness surfaces, the ROIs are added to it.

outputs.description: The cortexmap output, containing the surfaces and mapped data
A directory containing all of the derivatives generated. Useful for QA and debugging

parameters.description: FreeSurfer surface parcellation (.annot) converted to GIFTI label files and written to the cortexmap label folder.
Which bundled fsaverage subject (fsaverage to fsaverage6) provides the surfaces the ROIs are mapped onto.
If you want to smooth the volumes before mapping to surface, input smoothing kernel (fwhm) here. If not, leave blank
If you want to smooth the surface ROIs after mapping to surface, input smoothing kernel here. If not, leave blank
if you want to treat zeros as not being data, set as true
If you want to treat "surface_smooth_kernel" as a fwhm instead of sigma, set to true
if endpoints don't completely map, try making this a negative value (-1)
